title: Nice table, easy to assemble.
text:
Nice table, easy to assemble.. This is a nice table it was easy to assemble.

the description doesn't match the photo, but I did get the table that is in the photo. It says the measurement is 21.65''W x 21.65''D x 21.65''H for the table. That's for the end table. The description says it's an table, it's not. It's the longer, taller table. On the box it says it's a door. Just wanted to let you know this before ordering.

Table is well made. I don't think you'll be disappointed.

product_metadata.title: Amazon Brand – Ravenna Home Traditional Solid Pine End Table, 15.75"W, Black Finish
